title: Modernidades político-estéticas hispanas e historia de los conceptos
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Critical rereading of the Hispanic political-aesthetic modernities of the 20th-21st centuries from the history of the concepts and theories of the historical times of Reinhart Koselleck. Throughout twelve chapters, the main concepts that served to channel the debate on literary Modernity are historicized, paying attention to different historical moments and key figures in both Spain and America.
